clearing_the_fog.title: Clearing The Fog
clearing_the_fog.subtitle: Direct answers on how we eliminate waste, govern budgets, and execute.

items.question: Most businesses are currently being led by "Dronacharyas" who have grown too comfortable.
items.answer: You are likely paying for an in-house CMO taking a big fat paycheck to sit in meetings, or bleeding money on expensive agencies that deliver flashy creatives with zero business logic. They have lost their edge. Whether they are mismanaging your long-term roadmap or fumbling individual projects like your website, corporate AV, or product packaging, your budget is leaking through the cracks of uncoordinated execution and "black box" marketing.

items.question: I spent 21 years in the shadows, observing how the "Masters" actually work.
items.answer: I didn't just hold a seat; I held a 21-year vigil across top-tier agencies and India's largest loyalty management company. I watched elite strategies succeed and expensive ones fail. I didn't just decode high-level consumer data—I mastered the ground-level mechanics of production, design systems, and campaigns. I know exactly where big agencies inflate their markups and where standalone projects lose their traction.

items.question: Ekalavya Consulting is the "Middle Path" for brands that value Razor-Sharp Precision.
items.answer: We bridge the gap between high-level advisory and flawless execution. If you need long-term direction, we provide a complete Marketing Operating System to govern your budget. If you need to undertake specific, standalone tasks, we act as your Leadership & Execution machinery to get it done. We ensure that your overarching business strategy and your immediate physical or digital assets are perfectly synchronized.

items.question: I start by observing the battlefield that everyone else has become blind to.
items.answer: Whether you engage us for fractional leadership or a single complex project, our approach begins with observation. We audit your internal workflows, your empanelled partners, and your digital footprint. Before we suggest a single rupee of spend on a campaign or a new application, we ensure the foundation is built for a kill.

items.question: Strategy is nothing without the mastery of the pull.
items.answer: We take your brand from concept to conversion with zero friction. As your Creative & Strategic Governor, I manage the entire process for you. For our Fractional CMO clients, this means total portfolio accountability. For our standalone project clients, it means deploying my trusted network of specialized resources to deliver corporate films, SEO websites, 3D systems, or B2B content with absolute, uncompromised finesse.

items.question: You don't need a royal army. You need the right archer.
items.answer: Whether you are a fast-scaling startup needing a long-term strategic ally, or a traditional mid-sized brand looking to execute a specialized marketing asset, the goal remains unchanged. Stop the "spray and pray" approach. It is time to shift from constant corporate noise to calculated, precise impact.

founder_section.name: Abhishek Bhowmick
bio_paragraphs: 21 years of experience with top global brands across India, Middle East and Europe.

Abhishek has 22+ years of experience with global brands. He started as a copywriter, moved into 360-degree campaign planning, and led teams at India’s biggest loyalty management company. He holds an MBA in Marketing from SP Jain School of Global Management.

Today, as founder and fractional CMO of Ekalavya Consulting, he helps brands fix their go-to-market and grow faster.

Ekalavya Consulting is named after Ekalavya of the Mahabharata, the archer who mastered the bow through focus and self-discipline. We work the same way: one aim, no wasted effort.
founder_section.quote: I observe in silence, plan in 360°, and strike with one arrow.
